svg.title: Projects, tasks and rollback
svg.desc: 21:9 sample Atlas board with a task detail drawer. An optimistic move was rolled back because a required file is missing; the toast explains why and offers try again.

g.text: Attach the final PDF before review.
Taylor: the PDF is still missing.
It’s back in in progress. Attach a file before client review.
Northstar Studio is fictional. Sample data. Illustrated rollback state.
